items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: That's Leon Teen and Pitt. Leon Teen and St. Charles Avenue.

ctx.x: Yeah, he is the proprietor of it. It used three pieces in there. He had a mandolin player with him. He had a guitar and he was playing bass. And so, he liked my violin playing. And he asked me, would I accept, would like a job, playing every night? So, after he knew my people, I told him, well, it felt good to me. I was still attending school, the Young University, during that time. So, that went up on St. Charles? Well, St. Charles, no, but they sold it. They sold it and renamed it the Gilbert's Academy. And…
How old would you have been then?
